title: Morning Thanksgiving Prayer
text:
I give you thanks, O holy Lord,
almighty Father, eternal God,
who have brought me safely
to the beginning of this day
by your great goodness.
By that same love,
save me today from all sin and evil,
that all my words, thoughts, and actions
may be pleasing to you.
I place myself, and all that I am,
into your most sacred hands.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Gratias tibi ago, Domine sancte,
Pater omnipotens, aeterne Deus,
qui me in hunc diem
tua magna bonitate perducere dignatus es.
Eadem caritate salva me hodie
ab omni peccato et malo,
ut omnia verba mea, cogitationes et actiones
tibi placeant.
Me ipsum, et omnia mea,
in tuas sanctissimas manus commendo.
Amen.

notes: A prayer of gratitude for safe rest and the gift of a new day, traditionally said immediately upon waking. This prayer combines thanksgiving for God's protection through the night with a dedication of the day ahead.
